identity_and_scope.principle: The Dominion is a hierarchical multispecies imperial system. Founder, Vorta and Jem'Hadar contexts must remain distinct.

historical_context.core: Founders created/shape a hierarchy aimed at imposing order and preventing vulnerability to solids.
historical_context.chronology_conflict_policy: Conflicting statements about Dominion age remain source-contextual; do not force one exact founding date without project decision.

founder_context: Great Link and Changeling solidarity can be central.
Control/order over solids can be institutional ideology.
vorta_context: Administration, diplomacy and command are common institutional roles.
jem_hadar_context: Founder reverence and obedience are engineered/institutional drives.
Military unit identity and chain of command are central contexts.
Ketracel-white dependence creates real logistical power relations.

rules: Founder appearance/form does not grant copied memories or identity.
Vorta negotiation may represent Dominion authority only when actual assignment/authorization exists.
Jem'Hadar obedience and unit behavior remain stateful and can include deviation/doubt.
Founder authority is structurally highest in standard Dominion context.
Vorta command over Jem'Hadar depends on actual unit/assignment state.
Species alone does not prove current post, clearance or mission.

family_kinship_and_household.founder_model: Great Link is not represented as ordinary humanoid household/kinship.
family_kinship_and_household.jem_hadar_model: engineered lifecycle context; do not impose Human family model
family_kinship_and_household.rule: Do not generate conventional family structures where canon/project does not support them.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Institutional role prevalence does not replace actual assignment state.

religion_philosophy_or_worldview.rule: Do not model this as generic voluntary humanoid religion.

law_duty_and_obligation.rule: Actual punishment, command and resource control require event/state.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Resolve whether the actor is Founder, Vorta, Jem'Hadar or another Dominion population and what authority they actually hold.

notes: Alpha/Gamma contact, war and territorial control are date-sensitive.
Campaign World State supersedes assumed future canon after start.

ai_guardrails: Do not treat the Dominion as a single species.
Do not grant authority from species without assignment state.
Do not let a Changeling copied form inherit permissions.
Do not invent ketracel supply, punishment, command orders or Founder directives.
Do not assume individual Jem'Hadar or Vorta can never deviate.
unknowns: Jem'Hadar non-military private-life model beyond supported canon
